module.title: Scales
module.detail: Right and left hand · scales, pentatonics and modes in C major

lessons.title: Up
lessons.skill: C major, one octave up, one note a beat

theme.title: Thumb under
theme.line: After the middle finger, the thumb slips under and the hand walks on up.

theme.title: Middle over
theme.line: Coming down, the middle finger reaches over the thumb to keep going.

lessons.title: Up and down
lessons.skill: Up and back down, one note a beat

theme.title: Turn at the top
theme.line: Up to the pinky, straight back down: under on the way up, over on the way down.

lessons.title: Two octaves
lessons.skill: C major, two octaves up, one note a beat

theme.title: Twice as far
theme.line: Two thumb-unders this time, and the pinky lands on the very top.

lessons.title: The left hand
lessons.skill: C major in the left hand, one octave up

theme.title: The other hand
theme.line: Pinky first. Going up, the middle finger crosses over the thumb.

lessons.title: The blues scale
lessons.skill: The C blues scale, up and back down

theme.title: The flat five
theme.line: Six notes. The G♭ between the four and the five is the blue one.

lessons.title: Major pentatonic
lessons.skill: C D E G A C, up and back

theme.title: Five that always fit
theme.line: Take the 4 and the 7 out of the major scale. What's left can't clash.

lessons.title: The relative minor
lessons.skill: A minor pentatonic: the same five keys, from A

theme.title: Same keys, other home
theme.line: C major and A minor share every key. Where you land decides which one you hear.

lessons.title: G major
lessons.skill: G A B C D E F♯ G, up and back

theme.title: Same hand, new key
theme.line: C, G, D, A and E all share one fingering. Learn it once, move it round the circle.

lessons.title: F major
lessons.skill: F G A B♭ C D E F: 1 2 3 4, 1 2 3 4

theme.title: The exception
theme.line: The thumb stays off the black keys. In F that means four fingers before the tuck, not three.

lessons.title: Mixolydian
lessons.skill: C D E F G A B♭ C: the flat seventh

theme.title: The flat seven
theme.line: Lower the seventh a half step and major stops pulling home. Disco house and the blues' major side.

lessons.title: Dorian
lessons.skill: C D E♭ F G A B♭ C: the raised sixth

theme.title: The bright minor
theme.line: Natural minor with the 6th raised. One note, and the minor lifts: the club's favourite mode.

theme.title: Thumb white, middle black
theme.line: Twelve half steps make an octave. The fingering is a rule, not a list: 1 on white, 3 on black, 2 between two whites.

later.title: Hands together
later.skill: Left and right together, an octave apart

later.title: Contrary motion
later.skill: Both hands from one note, mirrored

later.title: Thirds
later.skill: The scale two notes at a time

steps.title: Up
steps.about: Right hand, one note a beat, over the drums. Thumb on C, then index, middle. The thumb tucks under onto the fourth note, and the hand walks on to the pinky on the top C. Hold that a bar, then back to the thumb. Four runs a chorus.

coach.intro: C major, up. Thumb on C.
coach.change: Up the scale. One note a beat.
coach.hold: Up the scale. One note a beat.

steps.title: Down
steps.about: The way back: pinky on the top C, down to the thumb. Then the middle finger crosses over the thumb, and index, thumb bring you home to C. Hold it a bar, then from the top. Four runs a chorus.

coach.intro: C major, down. Pinky on C.
coach.change: Down the scale. Middle finger over the thumb.
coach.hold: Down the scale. Middle finger over the thumb.

steps.title: Up and down
steps.about: Both ways, one note a beat: up from C to C, turn on the pinky, and straight back down. The crossings are the whole game: thumb under on the way up, middle finger over on the way down. A beat to breathe, then again.

coach.intro: C major, up and over the top, and back.
coach.change: Up and over the top, and back down.
coach.hold: Up and over the top, and back down.
coach.passed: Clean. You can play a scale.

steps.title: Two octaves
steps.about: The same run, twice as far: up from C through the top C and on to the C above it. The thumb tucks under twice on the way, after the middle finger each time, and the pinky lands on the very top. One note a beat; a beat to breathe, then from the bottom again. Three runs a chorus.

coach.intro: C major, two octaves. Thumb on C.
coach.change: Up two octaves. Thumb under after the middle finger.
coach.hold: Up two octaves. Thumb under after the middle finger.
coach.passed: Clean. Two octaves in the hand.

steps.title: The left hand
steps.about: The same scale in the left hand, an octave lower. Pinky on C, then ring, middle, index, thumb. Now the middle finger crosses over the thumb, and index, thumb bring you to the top C. Hold it a bar, then from the pinky again. Four runs a chorus.

coach.intro: C major, left hand. Pinky on C.
coach.change: Up the scale. Middle finger over the thumb.
coach.hold: Up the scale. Middle finger over the thumb.
coach.passed: Clean. Both hands know the scale.

steps.title: The blues scale
steps.about: Six notes, every blues solo lives here: C E♭ F G♭ G B♭ C. Right hand, one note a beat: thumb, index, middle, ring, then the thumb tucks under onto the fifth and index, middle finish on the top C. Turn around and come straight back down. Three runs a chorus.

coach.intro: C blues scale. Thumb on C.
coach.change: Up the blues scale and back down.
coach.hold: Up the blues scale and back down.
coach.passed: Clean. That's the sound of the blues.

steps.title: Major pentatonic
steps.about: Five notes: C D E G A C. The fourth and the seventh are gone, and with them every note that can clash over a major groove. Thumb, index, middle; thumb under onto G; index, middle to the top. Back the same way. Four runs a chorus.

coach.intro: C major pentatonic. Thumb on C.
coach.change: Up the five notes and back.
coach.hold: Up the five notes and back.
coach.passed: Clean. Five notes, nothing to hit wrong.

steps.title: The relative minor
steps.about: The same five keys, from A: A C D E G A. Nothing moved but the home. Over the drums alone it is dark where C major was bright; that is the whole difference between major and minor. Same fingers, 1 2 3 then thumb under.

coach.intro: A minor pentatonic. Thumb on A.
coach.change: Same five keys, from A.
coach.hold: Same five keys, from A.

steps.title: G major
steps.about: A new key, the same hand: G A B C D E F♯ G, one black key. Thumb, index, middle, thumb under, index, middle, ring, pinky; back down with the middle finger over the thumb. If C major is in your fingers, so is this.

coach.intro: G major. Thumb on G.
coach.change: Up G major and back. F♯ under the ring finger.
coach.hold: Up G major and back. F♯ under the ring finger.
coach.passed: Clean. Two keys down, ten to go.

steps.title: F major
steps.about: F G A B♭ C D E F. The first flat, and the first key that breaks the fingering: the thumb can't sit on B♭, so the ring finger takes it and the thumb tucks under onto C. 1 2 3 4, then 1 2 3 4 again. Coming down, the ring finger crosses over.

coach.intro: F major. Thumb on F.
coach.change: Up F major: ring finger on B♭, thumb under onto C.
coach.hold: Up F major: ring finger on B♭, thumb under onto C.
coach.passed: Clean. The one that breaks the rule.

steps.title: Mixolydian
steps.about: C major with one note lowered: B becomes B♭. C D E F G A B♭ C. Major, but it no longer pulls home so hard: it sits. This is the scale of a dominant seventh chord, and of the blues' major side. Same fingering, the ring finger on the black key.

coach.intro: C Mixolydian. Thumb on C.
coach.change: Up and back. Hear the B♭ sit.
coach.hold: Up and back. Hear the B♭ sit.
coach.passed: Clean. That B♭ is the blues' seventh.

steps.title: Dorian
steps.about: C minor with the sixth raised: C D E♭ F G A B♭ C. Two flats, the middle finger and the ring finger on black keys going up. Minor, but lifted. This is the scale under deep house and melodic techno.

coach.intro: C Dorian. Thumb on C.
coach.change: Up and back. The A is the colour.
coach.hold: Up and back. The A is the colour.

steps.title: Chromatic
steps.about: Every key from C to C, thirteen notes. The rule: thumb on the white keys, middle finger on the black ones, and where two white keys meet (E F, B C) the index takes the second. Up only, one a beat; the jam comes back down.

coach.intro: C chromatic. Thumb on C, middle finger on C♯.
coach.change: Every key. Thumb white, middle black.
coach.hold: Every key. Thumb white, middle black.

steps.title: First riff
steps.about: The first four notes of the scale as a riff: C D E G going up, then back down. One note a beat over the band's shuffle. Lean into the beat; the band does the rest.

coach.intro: Riff in C major. Thumb on C.
coach.change: C, D, E, G, and back.
coach.hold: C, D, E, G, and back.

steps.title: Falling riff
steps.about: From the top C down (C A G E), then climb back to it and hold it a beat. Pinky on the top, thumb at the bottom, just like the scale coming down.

coach.intro: Falling riff. Pinky on the top C.
coach.change: Down from the top, then back up.
coach.hold: Down from the top, then back up.

steps.title: The blue note
steps.about: The riff again, with a blue note: C D E♭ E, then G E D C. The ring finger on the flat note is what makes it sound like the blues. One note a beat, two bars, and again.

coach.intro: The blue note. Lean on it.
coach.change: Up to the blue note, then back down.
coach.hold: Up to the blue note, then back down.

steps.title: The jump
steps.about: Not a scale this time: the chord's own notes, C E G C, up to the octave and back. The fingers skip keys, so the hand opens up: thumb at the bottom, pinky on the octave.

coach.intro: The jump. Thumb at the bottom.
coach.change: Up through the chord, pinky on the octave.
coach.hold: Up through the chord, pinky on the octave.

steps.title: Walking bass
steps.about: The band's bass sits out and you take its place: C E G A walking up, then back down, one note a beat in the left hand. Pinky on C, and keep it even: a bass player never rushes.

coach.intro: Walking bass. Pinky on the low C.
coach.change: Walk it up, walk it down. Even.
coach.hold: Walk it up, walk it down. Even.

steps.title: Blues riff
steps.about: The blues scale as a lick: up through C E♭ F G♭ G B♭ C, with the flat five squeezed in late on beat 3 (the shuffle's late eighth), a beat of air on top, and back down the same way. This is the shape of every blues solo you've ever heard.

coach.intro: Blues riff. Thumb on C.
coach.change: Up the blues scale, the flat five late, and back.
coach.hold: Up the blues scale, the flat five late, and back.

steps.title: Pentatonic riff
steps.about: A riff on the five notes over the band: up, down from the top, a late eighth into the turn, home. Every note sits on the blues band, so lean on the beat and listen.

coach.intro: Pentatonic riff. Thumb on C.
coach.change: Up, down, lean on the late eighth.
coach.hold: Up, down, lean on the late eighth.

steps.title: Dark riff
steps.about: The minor pentatonic over the C blues band: the relative minor fits every chord of the blues. The same shape you played in C, heard in the shade.

coach.intro: Dark riff. Thumb on A.
coach.change: Up through the minor, back down.
coach.hold: Up through the minor, back down.

steps.title: G major riff
steps.about: The pentatonic riff you know, moved to G. The band moves with you: the blues in G.

coach.intro: G major riff. Thumb on G.
coach.change: The same riff, a fifth up.
coach.hold: The same riff, a fifth up.

steps.title: F major riff
steps.about: The riff in F, over the blues in F. Three keys now: C, G and F, one riff.

coach.intro: F major riff. Thumb on F.
coach.change: The riff, a fifth down.
coach.hold: The riff, a fifth down.

steps.title: Lean on the seventh
steps.about: C D E G, B♭ G E D, home, a late eighth, and B♭ G E C down: the flat seventh on the strong beats, over the whole C blues band, which plays C7 under you.

coach.intro: Lean on the seventh. Thumb on C.
coach.change: C D E G, B♭ G E D. The seventh on the beat.
coach.hold: C D E G, B♭ G E D. The seventh on the beat.

steps.title: Dorian vamp
steps.about: C D E♭, then G A B♭ G, home, and B♭ A G back down: a two-bar vamp with the A on the strong beat. Drums and bass, the bass on the roots.

coach.intro: Dorian vamp. Thumb on C.
coach.change: C D E♭, G A B♭. The sixth on the beat.
coach.hold: C D E♭, G A B♭. The sixth on the beat.

steps.title: Chromatic, down
steps.about: The way back: C B B♭ A A♭ G F♯ F E E♭ D C♯ C, one a beat over the band. Same rule, mirrored: the thumb lands on every white key, the middle finger drops onto every black one.

coach.intro: Chromatic, down. Thumb on C.
coach.change: Every key, coming down.
coach.hold: Every key, coming down.

jams.title: First riff
jams.skill: C D E G, up and back, over the band
jams.goal: Have fun. A clean chorus marks it played.

theme.title: A riff, not a run
theme.line: Four notes up and back. Sit on the beat and let the band carry you.

jams.title: Falling riff
jams.skill: C A G E, then G A C: a riff that drops from the top
jams.goal: Have fun. A clean chorus marks it played.

theme.title: From the top
theme.line: Start high, drop down, climb back. A riff can go either way.

jams.title: The blue note
jams.skill: C D E♭ E, then G E D C: the flat third slips in
jams.goal: Have fun. A clean chorus marks it played.

theme.title: Lean on the blue note
theme.line: The E♭ is the one that bends the ear. Give it weight.

jams.title: The jump
jams.skill: C E G C: the chord's notes, up an octave and back
jams.goal: Have fun. A clean chorus marks it played.

theme.title: Chord tones
theme.line: Skip the steps: root, third, fifth, octave. The hand opens up.

jams.title: Walking bass
jams.skill: C E G A in the left hand: you are the bass now
jams.goal: Have fun. A clean chorus marks it played.

theme.title: You're the bass
theme.line: One note a beat, dead even. A bass player never rushes.

jams.title: Blues riff
jams.skill: C E♭ F G♭ G B♭ C with a shuffle, up and down
jams.goal: Have fun. A clean chorus marks it played.

theme.title: The late eighth
theme.line: The flat five lands on the shuffle's late eighth: that's the swing.

jams.title: Pentatonic riff
jams.skill: The five notes as a riff, over the band
jams.goal: Have fun. A clean chorus marks it played.

theme.title: Any order works
theme.line: A pentatonic riff has no wrong turns. Pick the beat, the notes take care of themselves.

jams.title: Dark riff
jams.skill: A minor pentatonic over the band
jams.goal: Have fun. A clean chorus marks it played.

theme.title: The shady side
theme.line: Rock, blues, every minor hook: this scale. Same fingers as the major.

jams.title: G major riff
jams.skill: The pentatonic riff in G, over the blues in G
jams.goal: Have fun. A clean chorus marks it played.

theme.title: Transposed
theme.line: Same shape, same fingers, every key a fifth up. The band follows.

jams.title: F major riff
jams.skill: The pentatonic riff in F, over the blues in F
jams.goal: Have fun. A clean chorus marks it played.

theme.title: Three keys, one riff
theme.line: C G F: the riff is the same, your ear hears the band change under it.

jams.title: Lean on the seventh
jams.skill: C D E G and the B♭, over C7
jams.goal: Have fun. A clean chorus marks it played.

theme.title: The seventh chord's scale
theme.line: C7 is C E G B♭. Mixolydian is that chord with the steps between filled in.

jams.title: Dorian vamp
jams.skill: A two-bar vamp with the A on the beat
jams.goal: Have fun. A clean chorus marks it played.

theme.title: One chord, one mode
theme.line: Electronic harmony is mostly static: one mode over one root. Dorian is the one.

jams.title: Chromatic, down
jams.skill: C to C, every key, the way back
jams.goal: Have fun. A clean chorus marks it played.

theme.title: The mirror
theme.line: Down is up backwards: the same fingers on the same keys, the thumb landing instead of tucking.
